recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future clarification about whether SearchParameter.target is documentary or computational should be handled under FHIR-53110 or another final later issue, not under FHIR-27128.
issue_request: FHIR-27128 asked to split or narrow the core clinical-encounter search parameter because EpisodeOfCare is not a valid target for every base resource. The Published Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead required usage notes on SearchParameter.target explaining that target lists may include targets not valid for every base resource while still SHOULD-covering all permitted targets.
initial_application: Commit 67ebcdcc0ca2aa01481070b0daf9795be084f0f3 added the FHIR-27128 usage note on 2022-05-14, and 70ac631ab5a8bfd247ea76a30072d0a78da47cc0 immediately corrected the XML element name from comments to comment. Later refactoring preserved the same note in the active SearchParameter StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes searchparameter=SearchParameter, so source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-08-24 confirm the FHIR-27128 motion and vote. Later SearchParameter.target-related items found during bounded searching do not change this seed decision: FHIR-31714 and FHIR-48481 are already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-53110 is Triaged and unresolved.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml already has the approved SearchParameter.target comment with the clinical-encounter example and SHOULD guidance.
